String.string:
[EN] The Guardian of Velika
[ES] El guardián de Velika
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Glory to Valkyon's new champion!
[ES] ¡Gloria al nuevo campeón de Valkyon!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Very well."
[ES] "Muy bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] It's an emergency recall order. Report to Baruch in Tulufan.
[ES] Es una orden de retirada de emergencia. Preséntate ante Baruch en Tulufan.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll do that."
[ES] "Lo haré."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go back to Velika and speak with Troius at the pegasus platform.
[ES] Regresa a Velika y habla con Troius en la plataforma de pegasos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I'll find him.
[ES] Lo encontraré.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Adjutant Uriela in front of the Valkyon Federation Headquarters in Velika.
[ES] Preséntate ante la Adjutant Uriela frente al cuartel general de la Federación Valkyon en Velika.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you, sir."
[ES] "Gracias, señor."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Commander Seir at Valkyon Federation Headquarters in Velika.
[ES] Ve con el Commander Seir al cuartel general de la Federación Valkyon en Velika.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Lead the way."
[ES] "Guía el camino."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Elleon waiting in front of the goddess's statue near Velik's Stairs in Velika.
[ES] Ve con Elleon, quien te espera frente a la estatua de la diosa cerca de Velik's Stairs en Velika.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Honored to be of service."
[ES] "Honrado de ser de utilidad."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Elleon.
[ES] Habla con Elleon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
